steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: ...And so, this group of criminals who fled to WhiteSands has been apprehended. However, the leader of their town somehow found out about you and specifically requested that the Chief of MBCC oversee the extradition process.
In your office, an employee from Nirvana is explaining the specifics of this request to you.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: Therefore, the Council hopes you can spare some time to make the trip... There won't be much required of you, and FAC will handle all security arrangements. Your presence alone would be greatly appreciated.
You glance at your work schedule and find that you do have some free time coming up. The task itself sounds simple enough to be treated as a nice little getaway to unwind.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: That couldn't be better. On behalf of Nirvana, we really appreciate your understanding...
You wave a hand, cutting off his pleasantries. While you have to play nice and work together with Nirvana for Paradeisos's sake, you've never really liked these people, not deep down.
Is there anything else? If not...

steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: Just a moment, please. There are a few other matters I'd like to bring to your attention.
You knew it—these Nirvana people always have ulterior motives. They don't go away that easily.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: Here's the situation: we've recently learned that an Eastside fugitive has fled to that same town. According to reliable sources, this individual is a Sinner with dangerous abilities.
Do you have any identifying information?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: Yes, we do. Her name is Parfait, and she refers to herself as Eastside's "investment guru." You may have heard of her.
Yeah, I've heard of her. But I've always been curious, what exactly did she do to get on your radar?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: Six months ago, Parfait used various methods to fabricate massive amounts of false information about Hypercubes. This scheme resulted in catastrophic financial losses for hundreds of investors and caused irreparable harm to the Hypercube market's stability.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: Truth be told, we consider her the most damaging financial criminal DisCity has ever seen...
Alright, I get it. I'll keep an eye out for this Parfait when I'm there... But don't get your hopes up too high. She may well be gone before I arrive.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: Of course, we completely understand. We knew this would take time from the very beginning. Honestly, just having you keep an eye on the situation is already an enormous help to us.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Employee
steps.content: Here's Parfait's complete dossier. We're not expecting you to arrest her. If you could just gather some firsthand intelligence when convenient, we'd be extremely grateful...
Couldn't get a single useful lead in the end...

The sand ship's engines roar to life as it prepares to depart. You close Parfait's dossier, thinking back on the past few days. You had asked about her—both deliberately and in passing—but turned up nothing useful.
Forget it...
You slip the dossier back into your bag. The business trip isn't particularly long, but despite what the Nirvana employee claimed, the days have been packed with plenty of work to keep you busy.
When it was finally over, you deliberately booked passage on a civilian sand ship for the return trip, even put on a bit of a disguise, all to avoid any work talk during the journey.
Only after you adjust your hat and mask, settling into your seat, do you finally exhale in relief. At last, some proper downtime.
Excuse me...

Your seatmate shows up just as the sand ship is about to depart, rushing to reach you. Despite the hurry, she carries herself with grace—polite, courteous, even elegant. But something about her demeanor strikes you as a little... practiced.
This is your first time paying your own way on a civilian sand ship, and you didn't splurge on first class or business class. For the next few hours, this stranger will be your closest companion.
You shift aside to let her pass, taking the opportunity to discreetly size her up.
Thank you.

She squeezes past you and settles into her seat with perfect posture, taking a moment to smooth any wrinkles from her clothes. Then she lowers her tray table and begins unpacking her bag: a stack of financial newspapers, a mysterious paper-wrapped parcel, a tiny bottle of aromatherapy oil, an exquisite traveling tea set, and—of all things—a hand-crank coffee grinder.
With practiced efficiency, she arranges everything on the small tray table. Then, unfolding the parcel, she tips a handful of coffee beans into the grinder and begins turning the crank.
Excuse me, do you have any hot water... Wonderful, thank you.

You watch, utterly mesmerized, as she accepts hot water from the attendant, filters her fresh coffee grounds, and somehow still flips through the newspaper while she waits. The rich, nutty aroma leaves no doubt: these are premium beans.

As the coffee finishes brewing, she lifts her porcelain cup with deliberate grace. Even performing this elaborate ritual in the cramped space, she maintains an effortless elegance. You can't help but be impressed.
Somehow, you find her face familiar.
Would you like some?
Apparently catching your curious gaze, your seatmate gives you a smile and lifts her coffee pot.
That coffee aroma is impossible to resist... Just one small sip wouldn't hurt, you think.

You pull out a paper cup from the passenger amenity kit. Though everything about her screams refinement, she doesn't bat an eye at your flimsy drinkware. Instead, she pours you a careful half-cup with a smile.
You're not reckless enough to accept a drink from a stranger you've met for barely ten minutes. You shake your head in polite refusal.
She doesn't press the matter, simply offering a courteous smile in response.
Still, the brief exchange breaks the ice. The more you study her features, the stronger that nagging sense of familiarity grows, until curiosity wins out.
Are you from DisCity? Or...
Eastside.
She finishes her coffee and quickly wipes the cup clean before putting it away.
I've spent some time around WhiteSands for work, and now I have a few matters to attend to in Eastside. So, I'm on my way back.
So, what do you do for work?
Just a bit of financial investing here and there.
Finance? Wait, you're not some big shot from Eastside, are you?
No, no...
She demurs, quickly waving her hand.
I've been fortunate to receive such kindness from my fellow investors in Eastside, and while they've generously referred to me as an "investment guru," I'm afraid the title is far too flattering...
Truthfully, my passions lie more in the realms of art, cuisine, and fashion. Rather than a financier, I suppose you could say I fancy myself a "professional hedonist."

Your gaze flicks unconsciously to your bag holding the dossier. Now you're certain. That's why she looked familiar. This passenger sitting right next to you is none other than the fugitive you've been chasing.

You booked a civilian ship ticket precisely to avoid trouble, yet here it is, coming to you anyway. Well, if that's how it is, you'll play your part. A few more hours of keeping her calm and unsuspecting, and this journey will be over.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: To actually meet a kindred spirit aboard a sand ship... what extraordinary luck this is.

Parfait presses a hand to her chest and sighs wistfully, with the look of someone who regrets not meeting you sooner. All that mental gymnastics you've done in the past few hours, scrambling to keep up with her art theory tangents, has apparently paid off.
Not at all, I just happen to know some friends who work in the arts.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Oh, you're far too modest. Your depth of knowledge and cultural refinement couldn't possibly come just from knowing some friends. Some of your insights on music and fine arts are truly remarkable. I must admit, they leave me in awe.
You offer an awkward smile. There are quite a few artists in the Bureau, and you've mostly picked things up through osmosis. A few more hours of this, and you'd be fresh out of borrowed knowledge.
But of course, you can't possibly explain any of this to her.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Speaking of which, I actually came back specifically for this year's Spring Concert. A fine gentleman as yourself surely wouldn't miss it, would you?
steps.female_content: Speaking of which, I actually came back specifically for this year's Spring Concert. A fine lady as yourself surely wouldn't miss it, would you?

steps.content: ...I suppose so.

Unfortunately, you've never even heard of this Spring Concert, and barring any surprises, your schedule wouldn't allow it anyway. Right now, all you can do is offer a vague reply and hope the conversation moves on.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: That would be absolutely wonderful!
The sand ship begins to slow down. Through the window, dock workers materialize in the gloom, their signal batons cutting bright arcs through the darkness as they guide the vessel home.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: It seems our time together has come to an end... Well, I've never once wished a sand ship voyage could last longer. Oh, before you go... might I offer you a ride back? I'd be happy to accompany you.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: My business partner will be arriving shortly in my extended Wraith. I had the interior custom-designed by the finest artisans. No expense spared, of course. And I always keep my personal wine selection on hand. Would you...

You watch Parfait extend these lavish offers from her economy-class seat, strangely charmed by her enthusiasm. There's no artifice in her expression but genuine excitement at the prospect of sharing something wonderful with a new friend.

Still, you politely decline. After all, you've just uncovered that this so-called investment guru has an accomplice. The Bureau's operations department needs to be alerted—and reinforcements dispatched—immediately.
Thank you, but I have plans with a friend.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I see... What a shame. But that's quite all right. So long as we're both in DisCity, I'm certain our paths will cross again.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Will her accomplice really show up...?
You sit in the Bureau's vehicle, watching Parfait through the window. She hasn't moved from her spot in the parking lot for nearly an hour, luggage at her side.

Every few minutes, she tries her terminal again, but each call fails to connect. Around her, the lot empties. The wind picks up, sharp with the late-hour chill, but still, no one comes for her. By now, she's hugging herself against the cold, shoulders hunched.
Forget it. Let's close the net.
The car slowly pulls up, and you roll down the window, waving at Parfait. She's still shivering in the cold, her nose red and on the verge of running.
Need a ride?
The biting wind has left her half-numb, her thoughts sluggish. When she looks up at her unexpected rescuer, her face lights up with nothing but pure, unguarded gratitude.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Thank you so much...
Once inside the Bureau's walls, even Parfait couldn't fail to recognize you forever, and the moment of realization finally comes.
Now she sits in the interrogation chair, no longer the shivering, miserable figure from the parking lot, but once again displaying the elegant composure you first encountered.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Who could have imagined my first encounter with the distinguished MBCC Chief would be quite so... undignified? Though I must admit, there's a certain charm in the unexpected. Perhaps one day, this will serve as a rather entertaining story over cocktails.
With that said, her face shows not a trace of embarrassment. She simply leans forward in her chair, hand outstretched toward you.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Allow me to introduce myself properly. I am Parfait Medici, Executive Director and Investment Advisor at Tulip Holdings. It's an honor to make your acquaintance, Chief.
Parfait smiles, her hand lingering expectantly in mid-air as she waits for your response.
Your reputation as the investment guru certainly precedes you. I've been hearing about your impressive track record for some time now.

You're the orphaned heir of Robert Medici, a wealthy merchant who lived abroad. Since your return to DisCity in N.F. 108, you've become one of high society's most prominent figures. Through your accomplishments in finance, the arts, and other pursuits, you've earned a reputation as the epitome of Eastside aristocracy.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: You're too kind. As I mentioned before, it's all far too flattering...
Your "but" cuts through Parfait's modest deflection.

Ever since you disappeared from Eastside's public eye six months ago, your reputation as the "investment guru" has taken a steep nosedive. Even Tulip Holdings, where you're employed, is struggling with bankruptcy rumors right now.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: ...That's simply the way high society operates. No matter how earnestly I tried to connect with everyone, it's impossible to win them all over in the end.
Parfait sighs, her voice laced with quiet resignation.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Indeed, Tulip Holdings faced some unfavorable press six months ago when I was in the Outlands overseeing a significant business transaction that demanded my full attention. Regrettably, this meant I wasn't able to address the situation as promptly as I would have liked.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: As you can see, my enemies naturally took advantage of the circumstances to amplify rumors and distort the facts. I'm afraid that's also why my business partners felt compelled to withdraw... Of course, I understand the decision completely. Had I been in their position, I might have done the same.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: However...
Parfait lifts her head, the gloom vanishing from her expression, replaced by the polished confidence that only comes with success.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Now that Parfait has returned to DisCity, where her loyalty lies, the rumors will naturally fade away, and this entire situation will be resolved smoothly. Rest assured, the investment guru would never allow her investor friends to suffer any losses.
Is that so?
Parfait's response is confident and thorough, but the dossier from Nirvana tells a completely different story.
test
test
test
test
test
test

You pull out a stack of files: surveillance photos, intelligence reports, all the damning evidence. The top photo leaves no room for doubt—there's Parfait, leaning from a helicopter door, scattering Hypercubes by the handful.

Six months ago, you announced the discovery of an Outland Hypercube mine. However, there's still no visible progress on any mining operation. It appears your actions were nothing more than fraudulent market manipulation, with serious consequences for both Hypercube trade and DisCity's economy.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I must say, that seems a rather uncharitable remark. My return to DisCity is precisely to bring back the latest updates on the Outland Hypercube mine.
But the Hypercube situation was just the beginning.
You flip through the files, pointing at the photos as you continue.
After that incident, all of Eastside—from government officials to affected corporations—began investigating you. Some now question whether your entire identity is legitimate.

"Contrary to initial assumptions, Parfait is no aristocratic orphan but a West District slum native with a history of fraud. Notably, her emergence coincided precisely with Eastside's bank counterfeit currency case. With her Sinner status now confirmed, we assess she likely employed her abilities to facilitate these crimes."
For just a moment, you catch what looks like a crack in Parfait's composure, but by the time you study her expression again, that fleeting hitch is already gone.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Might I ask if these files—or more precisely, these unflattering reports—came from Nirvana?
Parfait gives a slight smile, seemingly unfazed by your response.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: This assertion about disrupting the Hypercube market is merely Nirvana's side of the story. After all, if there truly were no Hypercube mine in the Outlands, how would an ordinary investor like me have acquired such a substantial quantity?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: If you consider it thoughtfully, the discovery of an Outland Hypercube mine is undoubtedly an unequivocal boon for all of humanity with no conceivable drawbacks.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: The only ones who might oppose this—who would see their interests jeopardized—are Nirvana. After all, their corporate supremacy hinges entirely on their monopoly over Hypercubes. So...

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Naturally, they will resort to any means to undermine me, even exploiting my status as a Sinner, not just to attack me personally, but to tarnish the credibility of all the capital under my name.
After delivering that impassioned speech, Parfait pauses for a moment, looking deeply into your eyes.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Please tell me, Chief. Surely in today's DisCity, being a Sinner isn't still a crime, is it?
Before you can finish whatever comes after "No," Parfait quickly interjects with an exclamation.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Exactly. Just look at today's DisCity: whether among traders, the FAC, the Council, artists, or even Nirvana's own circle, Sinners can be found in every sphere of influence.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: It's already N.F. 115, and yet some still resort to exploiting antiquated Eastsider prejudices, to employing such crude and outdated tactics simply because I've challenged their monopoly. It's utterly absurd, don't you think?
Your status as a Sinner isn't the issue here. It's whether you've ever used your abilities for illegal activities.
Based on the intelligence and evidence from Nirvana regarding the counterfeit currency case, everything indeed points to your involvement.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Really?
Parfait tilts her head, her expression the perfect picture of innocence.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: But from my perspective, what they refer to as "damning evidence" appears to be little more than malicious speculation built on thin air.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: It is true that I have dined with individuals from the West District who may be connected to counterfeit currency distribution. But let me be clear: these were not private gatherings. On the contrary, invitations to Parfait's Dinner Party have always been extended publicly, as a matter of record.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: My guests represent every industry and district in DisCity, including, I might add, a number of my detractors—the very people now circulating these rumors. If their own logic were to be followed, wouldn't that implicate them just as readily in this accusation?
Parfait isn't wrong about this. When it comes to the counterfeit currency case, Nirvana only gave you circumstantial evidence, nothing concrete enough to challenge her claims.
Your silence doesn't go unnoticed. With a satisfied brush of her sleeves, Parfait meets your gaze, utterly self-assured.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: After all, this is neither a court of law nor the office of the Financial Inspection Team. Arguing over whether the evidence is comprehensive here seems rather pointless, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Frankly, if Nirvana truly had solid evidence, they would never have circumvented the proper channels by using you to detain me. Nor would they have wasted all this effort on their smear campaign against me.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: In fact, I would welcome the opportunity to face them in court and let them accuse me of identity fraud and counterfeiting. I'd be more than prepared to countersue for defamation and anti-competitive behavior.
So you came back specifically to take legal action against Nirvana?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: What? No, no, no. I have no interest in wasting my time on something like that.
Parfait quickly waves off your speculation.
Why not? One successful lawsuit could easily restore your reputation and save Tulip Holdings. Wouldn't that be worth it?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Hahaha, you've got it all wrong. Personal reputation lawsuits are pure bad debt. Even if I exhaust myself winning, the returns are negligible. It would only wear down the investors' patience without meaningful gain.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: What truly matters to investors, after all, is profitability—the potential for future returns. That's precisely why I've dedicated the past six months to advancing Hypercube's mining operations in the Outlands.
But you did come back after all. Couldn't you set the record straight while you're here?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: There's really no need for that. A touch of doubt can actually strengthen trust over time. Once the Hypercube shipments arrive, those making a scene now will surely be eager for a piece of the cake. Why indulge in pointless debates?

You have to admit, Parfait's arguments are compelling, airtight even. The kind of flawless logic you'd expect from a financial magnate. But the sharper her reasoning gets, the louder your instincts scream: This woman is hiding something big.
After all, by her own explanation, she shouldn't even be in DisCity right now.
Then what's the real reason you came back?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: For the Spring Concert, of course!
At the mention of the Spring Concert, Parfait's face lights up, her professional demeanor melting away as her eyes sparkle with childlike excitement.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Didn't I mention this to you on the sand ship? It's the most prestigious event for musicians across all of DisCity, and even the Outlands. This annual celebration has practically become DisCity's cultural emblem.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: And to think, Maestro Euragio announced at the start of the year that this Spring Concert would be his final public performance... My friends and I promised to attend together six months ago. I simply couldn't bear to disappoint them.

Watching Parfait's expectant expression, you find yourself inexplicably amused. In all your years dealing with DisCity's swindlers and criminals, you've never met someone who manages to be both cunning and naive at the same time.
After all, she's a major economic suspect specifically flagged by the higher-ups. There's no way you can let her attend some concert.
...Well, I'm afraid I'll have to disappoint you.
Parfait goes still. The eager anticipation in her expression instantly hardens into wariness.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I... don't understand what you mean.
As per regulations, the MBCC is responsible for monitoring Sinners suspected of criminal activity to protect DisCity from further harm.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: You... you must be joking. How could I possibly cause any...

Just to clarify, MBCC operates differently from the Public Security Bureau and Financial Inspection Team you're familiar with. Unlike those agencies, we don't permit bail. Also, we maintain detention authority over Sinners until their charges are fully resolved.
You catch a single drop of sweat glistening on Parfait's forehead.
I want to believe what you've told me, so I won't be sending you to Nirvana. But... the higher-ups have you flagged. I can't just let you walk out of here.

Here's the plan: with so many people looking to settle scores with you anyway, think of this as protective custody. You'll stay at the Bureau while we verify the intel together. Once everything checks out, you're free to go. Fair warning though, this could take some time.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: For... how long?
If all goes well, ten days to two weeks.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Can I go out at all during that time?
Strictly speaking, absolutely not...

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Wait!
Parfait, until now the picture of unshakable poise, suddenly shakes her head in a frantic manner.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Hold on, hold on... but the Spring Concert is next week!
You keep your professional composure, though duty clearly weighs on you.
Can't you watch the livestream?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: No, no, no... a livestream is an entirely different matter altogether!

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: A maestro's farewell performance, with the most extraordinary lineup in years. If I couldn't witness such a masterpiece in person, I'd carry that regret with me forever. Just the thought of missing it would leave me wistful for years to come...
Parfait looks utterly shattered. You didn't expect such a casual probe to hit so hard, and now you're starting to have your doubts.
Would an "investment guru" like her really crumble over a simple concert? Something doesn't add up, so you decide to dig deeper.
If it's that important to you, I could make an exception for that one night. But you'd be under full surveillance the entire time.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Do you mean it?
Parfait looks up at you pitifully, her eyes even shimmering with unshed tears.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: But... one night simply won't be enough. First, I'll need to secure tickets, considering presales ended ages ago. I'll have to reach out to someone from the box office directly.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: And then there are the friends I've invited. It's already been half a year since I left, and it would feel terribly unkind if I didn't make time to see them in person...
That's it! You're now finally closing in on Parfait's slip-up. There's no way her return to DisCity at such a delicate time is just about some concert.
The real reason must be hidden among the people she plans to meet this week.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Chief, please... this is really the one thing I couldn't bear to miss. After the concert, I'll gladly assist you with all you need, anything within my ability. You have my word.
I see...
You make a show of reluctance, though your mind is already working—you'll need to monitor Parfait closely during this time and catch her in the act.
Still, you can't agree too quickly, or she might get suspicious and figure out your real intentions.
As it turns out, I could use your help collecting some intel.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Please, go ahead! I'm more than happy to share everything I know! I won't hold back a single detail!
So, about six months ago, right during your most active period, I received an anonymous letter while on official duty.
Whoever sent it did me a real favor, but I'm sure they're sitting on far more valuable information. The problem is, I've spent half a year digging and still can't track them down.
I was thinking someone with your financial success and connections might be able to help uncover some leads?
Parfait's smile falters for just a heartbeat before she catches herself, her face lighting up again with practiced brightness as she answers.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Leave it to me. Once the concert's over, I'll reach out to my entire network to help you investigate this thoroughly!
I appreciate it.
And you'll need to share your schedule with me. I have to accompany you wherever you go... I hope you understand.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Of course. Please rest assured, I will not let you down.
At last, Parfait relaxes, her breath escaping in a long sigh of relief. This outcome isn't perfect, but one you can both live with.
